description: A shell script defining functions and logic for CI/CD pipeline management, including environment setup, branch/tag handling, build artifact checks, and CI-specific configurations.

methods.name: begin_group
methods.description: Starts a new CI group with environment-specific formatting and tracing.

methods.name: end_group
methods.description: Ends the current CI group, restoring environment state.

methods.name: group
methods.description: Wraps commands within a CI group, handling output and exit status.

methods.name: skip_branch_tip_with_tag
methods.description: Skips build if the branch is exactly at a tag different from the branch name.

methods.name: is_usable_git_repository
methods.description: Checks if a directory is a valid Git repository and Git is available.

methods.name: save_good_tree
methods.description: Records the current Git tree hash to avoid redundant builds.

methods.name: skip_good_tree
methods.description: Skips build if the current Git tree has been successfully built before.

methods.name: check_unignored_build_artifacts
methods.description: Checks for unignored build artifacts in the repository.

methods.name: handle_failed_tests
methods.description: Placeholder for handling failed tests, currently returns failure.

methods.name: create_failed_test_artifacts
methods.description: Collects and archives logs of failed tests for review.
